mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, symbol, name, market, type, quantity, price, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{symbol}, #{name}, #{market}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{price}, COALESCE(#{status}, '체결'), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS id, created_at AS date, type, market, name, symbol, quantity, price, (quantity * price) AS amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT order_id AS id, user_id AS userId, created_at AS date, type, market, name, symbol, quantity, price, (quantity * price) AS amount, status FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{id}
